description: Add, subtract, multiply and divide complex numbers. See the result in a+bi form with modulus, argument and conjugates.

faqs.a: A complex number has the form a + bi, where a is the real part, b is the imaginary part, and i is the imaginary unit with i² = −1.
By multiplying the numerator and denominator by the conjugate of the denominator: (a+bi)/(c+di) = ((ac+bd) + (bc−ad)i) / (c²+d²).

faqs.q: What are the modulus and argument?
faqs.a: The modulus |a+bi| = √(a²+b²) is the number's distance from the origin on the complex plane. The argument is its angle, atan2(b, a), shown in degrees.

howto: Enter the real and imaginary parts of the first complex number.
Enter the real and imaginary parts of the second complex number.
Choose add, subtract, multiply or divide.
Read the result in a+bi form, with modulus, argument and conjugates shown.
